changelog: Notes+ 19.4: reminders for list items (a notification at the item's time, even with the app closed), calmer and more readable mind map colours, home-screen widgets now listed by every launcher, "Save as template" in every note's menu, and the card shows the item due soonest. Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ 19.4 for Windows: reminders for list items, a date pane with Apply and a time wheel, lists that no longer open with blank gaps, Enter picks a [[ link title, Save as template in every note, calmer mind map colours.
